# Block `list`

**Use:** Learning objectives at the start of a lecture, or key takeaways at the end.

**Avoid:** Any other kind of list — write it in prose Markdown or a table.

## Example

```json
{
  "kind": "list",
  "variant": "takeaways",
  "items": [
    "Indexes speed up reads and slow down writes.",
    "Choose the index type by the query pattern."
  ],
  "source": [
    {
      "file": "slides.pdf",
      "page": 4
    }
  ]
}
```

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `"list"` | yes |
| `source` | array of object (1–5) | no |
| `source[].file` | string | yes |
| `source[].page` | integer (≤ 9007199254740991) | yes |
| `variant` | `"objectives"` \| `"takeaways"` | yes |
| `items` | array of string | yes |

Every block may carry `source`: 1–5 `{ "file", "page" }` references to the material it came from.
